Title: List employees — default pagination returns 50 records
Expected Result: HTTP 200; response body contains data array; meta.total is a positive integer; each record has empNumber, firstName, lastName, employeeId fields

Title: List employees — filter by firstName partial match
Preconditions: At least one employee with John in name exists
Expected Result: HTTP 200; all returned records contain John in firstName or lastName

Title: List employees — filter by employeeId exact match
Expected Result: HTTP 200; returned record employeeId equals 0672647683

Title: List employees — filter by employmentStatus
Preconditions: Admin session; at least one employment status configured
Steps: 1. GET /api/v2/admin/employment-statuses?limit=0 to obtain a valid status ID; 2. GET /api/v2/pim/employees?employmentStatusId={id}
Expected Result: HTTP 200; all returned employees match the requested employment status

Title: List employees — filter by jobTitle
Preconditions: Admin session; at least one job title configured
Steps: 1. GET /api/v2/admin/job-titles?limit=0 to obtain a valid jobTitleId; 2. GET /api/v2/pim/employees?jobTitleId={id}
Expected Result: HTTP 200; all returned employees match the requested job title

Title: List employees — filter by subUnit
Preconditions: Admin session; at least one sub-unit configured
Steps: 1. GET /api/v2/admin/subunits to obtain a valid subUnitId; 2. GET /api/v2/pim/employees?subunitId={id}
Expected Result: HTTP 200; all returned employees belong to the specified sub-unit

Title: List employees — pagination offset advances correctly
Steps: 1. GET with limit=50 offset=0; 2. GET with limit=50 offset=50
Expected Result: HTTP 200 on both; no overlapping empNumbers between pages

Title: List employees — filter with no matching results returns empty data array
Expected Result: HTTP 200; data array is empty; meta.total equals 0

Title: Create employee — happy path with required fields only
Expected Result: HTTP 200 or 201; response contains new empNumber; firstName and lastName match

Title: Create employee — with optional middleName and custom employeeId
Steps: 1. POST with firstName, middleName, lastName, employeeId
Expected Result: HTTP 200/201; middleName and employeeId returned correctly

Title: Create employee — missing required firstName returns validation error
Expected Result: HTTP 400 or 422; error references firstName

Title: Create employee — missing required lastName returns validation error
Expected Result: HTTP 400 or 422; error references lastName

Title: Create employee — firstName at maximum allowed length (100 chars)
Steps: 1. POST with firstName of exactly 100 a characters
Expected Result: HTTP 200/201; employee created successfully

Title: Create employee — firstName exceeds maximum allowed length (101 chars)
Steps: 1. POST with firstName of 101 a characters
Expected Result: HTTP 400 or 422; error indicates firstName is too long

Title: Create employee — special characters in firstName and lastName accepted
Expected Result: HTTP 200/201; employee created; values stored exactly as submitted

Title: Create employee — duplicate employeeId returns error
Preconditions: Admin session; employee with duplicate ID exists
Expected Result: HTTP 400, 409, or 422; error indicates duplicate employeeId

Title: Get employee by valid empNumber returns full record
Expected Result: HTTP 200; empNumber, firstName, lastName, employeeId fields present

Title: Get employee by non-existent empNumber returns 404
Expected Result: HTTP 404 or 422; no employee data

Title: Update personal details — happy path
Preconditions: Employee with known empNumber exists; admin session
Steps: 1. PUT personal-details with updated firstName; 2. GET to verify
Expected Result: HTTP 200 on PUT; GET reflects updated value

Title: Update personal details — empty required field returns validation error
Preconditions: Employee with known empNumber; admin session
Expected Result: HTTP 400 or 422; error references firstName

Title: Delete single employee — valid empNumber
Preconditions: Employee with known empNumber exists; admin session
Expected Result: HTTP 200 on DELETE; subsequent GET returns 404 or 422

Title: Bulk delete multiple employees — valid empNumbers
Expected Result: HTTP 200 on DELETE; all three GETs return 404 or 422

Title: Delete employee — non-existent empNumber returns error
Expected Result: HTTP 400 or 404; error returned

Title: Get job titles list returns all titles with limit=0
Preconditions: Admin session; at least one job title configured
Expected Result: HTTP 200; data non-empty; each entry has id and title

Title: Get employment statuses returns complete list
Expected Result: HTTP 200; data non-empty

Title: Get sub-units returns organizational hierarchy
Expected Result: HTTP 200; data non-empty; each entry has id and name

Title: Add Employee form renders all required fields
Expected Result: First Name, Last Name, Employee ID fields visible; Save button present

Title: Add Employee form shows inline validation on submit with blank required fields
Steps: 1. Navigate to Add Employee; 2. Clear required fields; 3. Click Save
Expected Result: Inline validation messages appear under First Name and Last Name

Title: Add Employee form — successful submission redirects to new employee profile
Steps: 1. Navigate to Add Employee; 2. Enter valid data; 3. Click Save
Expected Result: Browser navigates to new employee profile; URL contains empNumber

Title: Employee List table renders with data and column headers
Preconditions: Browser; logged in as Admin; employees exist
Expected Result: Table renders with column headers; at least one data row visible

Title: Employee List search form submits and filters table
Steps: 1. Navigate to Employee List; 2. Enter Ranga in search; 3. Click Search
Expected Result: Table refreshes; only rows containing Ranga shown

Title: End-to-end: Create employee, search, view profile, update, verify persists
Steps: 1. Log in; 2. Add employee; 3. Search; 4. Open profile; 5. Edit middle name; 6. Save; 7. Re-login; 8. Verify
Expected Result: Employee in search results; middle name persists after re-login
